name: Might and Magic: Clash of Heroes Vita

description: Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes is a puzzle strategy role-playing game originally developed for the Nintendo DS by Capybara Games and published by Ubisoft Entertainment. Tag Games created an Android version in 2013, which this PSVita port is based on.
